hypothesis: Independent development pilot indicates high D recall but many missed control phases. The fixed H/A switching penalty can erase short genuine control; reduce only that penalty while retaining minimum duration and stoppage costs.
basis: J03WMX development pilot and generic decoder objective; no competition labels or candidate scores used
change: Responsive profile uses incumbent evidence unchanged. Compare H/A switch costs [4,8,12] with incumbent 20; no reliability filter, no training, no other parameter changes.
split_selection: Additional next lexicographic IDs declared before their labels/scores are inspected; previously reserved final remains final.
selection: Among candidates passing mean gain and per-match nonnegative primary gain and secondary regression limits, maximise unweighted mean spellF1; exact ties favour larger switch cost. If none qualify retain incumbent and do not open final labels.
stopping_rule: Evaluate three fixed candidates once on development. Freeze selected configuration/source/manifest. Evaluate selected candidate and incumbent once on both reserved final matches. No retuning on final results; failure retains incumbent. No competition public scores for selection or rollback.
limitations: Conservative engineering gates, not official requirements or proof of significance. Four games and cleaner provider tracking limit transfer claims. No held-out evaluation until two development matches and synthetic contracts pass.
